many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

import json
G=[[8]*22 for _ in range(26)]
# periodic motif in left panel, 9x6
m1=[[0,0,1],[0,1,0],[1,1,0]]
for r in range(9):
 for c in range(6): G[2+r][3+c]=m1[r%3][c%3]
# middle panel, 8x6
m2=[[4,0],[4,4]]
for r in range(8):
 for c in range(6): G[4+r][13+c]=m2[r%2][c%2]
# lower panel, 6x8
m3=[[3,0,3,3],[0,3,0,3],[3,3,0,3]]
for r in range(6):
 for c in range(8): G[16+r][3+c]=m3[r%3][c%4]
print(json.dumps({'action':'submit','grid':G},separators=(',',':')))
